title: Pose-estimation gait features classify sarcopenia in musculoskeletal patients
summary: BlazePose video landmarks and smart-insole gait measures supported sarcopenia classification in 83 musculoskeletal patients, including 23 classified using AWGS criteria. Random forest, support vector and neural models were evaluated after a patient-level train/test split. Some combinations performed strongly in this small internal sample, but external diagnostic accuracy and benefits for patient management were not established.
